serverInfo.title: Trooth
serverInfo.description: Read any company's record on the Trooth Network, each fact labeled with who said it and when. Every company on the Trooth Network has one public Trust Profile, and every section of it is readable here: identity, history, funding, products, pricing, integrations, security, privacy, AI practices, hosting, infrastructure, procurement, relationships, customer proof, people, documents, evidence and trust cards, each with who said it and what to say when it is empty. Find, search and list companies, read a whole profile or one fact, and see how a record changed, with no account. With your trooth.co sign-in, 79 more tools work on your own workspace, 74 of them also with the workspace's agent key: read, change and publish your Trust Profile, and work your connected stack, team, settings, developer keys and audit log. Trooth says who said each fact and when.
